'''Sul Dekkon''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Chagrian/Legends|Chagrian]] [[Lawyer/Legends|lawyer]], appointed to act as prosecution in the [[Trial of Tahiri Veila|trial]] against former [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Tahiri Veila]], who was being tried for the [[Death/Legends|murder]] of [[Gilad Pellaeon/Legends|Gilad Pellaeon]] during the [[Second Galactic Civil War]]. He squared off against [[Bothan/Legends|Bothan]] defense attorney [[Eramuth Bwua'tu]].

Dekkon often wore decorative spheres, made of materials such as polished ebonium, on the tips of his [[Lethorn/Legends|lethorns]].<ref name="Vortex">''[[Fate of the Jedi: Vortex]]''</ref><ref name="Allies">''[[Fate of the Jedi: Allies]]''</ref>
